title: UNVERIFIED — The Arcade in the Low View

features.name: the-neon-through-the-window
features.desc-on-touch: The arcade lives outside, across the street. Its lights bleed through the glass and color the dust that drifts across pages you will never finish reading.

features.name: the-couch-and-its-reader
features.desc-on-touch: A low place where time holds still. The book is open; the person reading it has made a choice to stay here, in this moment, while the world and its arcades continue outside.

features.name: the-car-that-slowed
features.desc-on-touch: Headlights swept across the front window. Someone was looking for someone. The car did not stop.

inscription: the arcade games blink in the peripheral light while someone stays still and reads

file.name: Half_Read_Book_Dogear_Page_147.txt
file.note: The last page read aloud in a whisper, never finished: they asked if I wanted to go. I asked what was outside. They said the arcade, and the car, and tomorrow. I turned the page instead

reverie.title: REVERIE — the couch where you chose to stay
narr: The couch holds the shape of two bodies now, though only
one reads. Arcade light blooms and fades on the opposite
side of glass. A car slows outside; you both listen without
looking. She asks if you want to go. You turn a page instead.
The light comes and goes. The book in your hands is warm.
This is the moment you will stay. This is the choice.

exits.label: back to the couch by the front window, where the choice is still being made
across the street to the arcade where the lights still blink
deeper into the book, to the pages that were never reached
